name: intro-pages-5s
title: New game: the introduction pages advance every 5 seconds instead of every 10
why: While a new map is generated, check_timer_tick (1040:843c) shows the ten pages of
opening_scene (credits, then who you are, which nation, which monarch) one every 600
ticks of MSGetTicks, which counts 60ths of a second: 10 s a page. new_game_setup then
spins on check_timer_tick(1) until the last page has shown, so a player who does not
click waits up to ~100 s. A click or key already dismisses the rest once the map is
done; this only shortens the wait for a player who reads rather than clicks.
The threshold is the imm32 of `cmp eax,600`; 300 = 5 s keeps a one-line page readable.
test: Start a new game and do not click during map generation. The pages turn about every
5 s (was 10 s), and the game reaches the map about half as soon. A click still skips.
status: bytes and behaviour checked; not yet confirmed in play
